Product_Name: BLACK+DECKER 8,000 BTU Portable Air Conditioner up to 350 Sq.Ft.with Remote Control, White
Ai_text: Customers like the ease of assembly of the air conditioner. For example, they mention the remote is easy to use and the window mounting assembly is easy. That said, some complain about the leaking. Opinions are mixed on temperature, performance, noise, quality, value, and size.
